purpose: Research-only handoff for nums 21-40 in data.js / MOVIES_BASE. Built from live Common Sense Media refetches of the catalog srcUrl pages. Do not treat as production data until reviewed and transformed through the official workflow.

contentFlagModel.mappingNote: This refetch preserves CSM's current visible category label and proposes the nearest app level. Where CSM's label and category detail conflict, the proposed level may reflect the detail rather than the label and a handoff note is included.

entries.title: Penguins
entries.implementationNote: This entry covers the previously missed data.js/MOVIES_BASE scope.

violence.summary: Natural-world peril includes skuas, killer whales, and leopard seals killing or threatening penguins and eggs, plus a storm burial scare and rough chick behavior.

language.summary: CSM does not surface language concerns.

romance.summary: Penguin mating rituals, mate-finding jokes, nuzzling, nest-building, and elephant seal mating-season imagery are presented as nature-documentary content.

drinking.summary: CSM does not surface drinking, drug, or smoking content.

handoffNotes: Predator deaths of eggs, chicks, and penguins may need soft prose for sensitive viewers.
